entities.summary: Antonio Basagoiti Pastor is a Spanish banker and former politician of the People's Party (PP). He was a member of Bilbao City Council from 1995 to 2008, a member of the Basque Parliament from 2009 to 2013, and president of the People's Party of the Basque Country from 2008 to 2013. He then left politics and moved to Mexico to resume his banking career.
